issues.title: Al-Fayez: Jordan will not tolerate money laundering or terrorism financing
issues.title_en: Al-Fayez: Jordan will not tolerate money laundering or terrorism financing
issues.summary: Senate President Faisal Al-Fayez said Jordan has taken advanced, internationally recognised steps to combat money laundering and terrorist financing, steps that have stabilised the Kingdom's financial system and strengthened its investment climate.
issues.volunteer_impact: 현지 활동과 이동에 영향을 줄 수 있어 현지 상황 확인이 우선 필요합니다.
